part_c_direct_vs_indirect.verdict: Model B (corrected) has xB_outsiders_zero=True at the optimum, and Model C (Stage 5 indirect) gives a strictly worse objective than Model A when applied to Model B's bitstring. The corrected mapping is preferred.

delta_e_sign_doc:
DeltaE = E_delivered - E_requested (Stage 1 §4.2)

  DeltaE < 0  ==>  unmet demand:  E_delivered < E_requested
  DeltaE = 0  ==>  demand exactly met
  DeltaE > 0  ==>  over-delivery:  E_delivered > E_requested

Stress model interpretation: a scenario with DeltaE < 0 means the user's
*realized* demand was higher than what the schedule provided, i.e. the
schedule under-served the user.

verdict.part_c: Model B (corrected, M_window) reproduces Model A (direct) optimum to machine precision. Model C (Stage 5 indirect, R_i only) finds a *lower* objective because it fails to exclude out-of-window slots. The Stage 5 indirect mapping is replaced by the corrected Model B.
verdict.part_e: Corrected robust QUBO passes exhaustive validation on K=4, K=8, K=16 (all 2^11=2048 bitstrings checked) to within machine precision (max dev 4e-10 at K=8/K=16 due to k-means rounding, 5e-14 at K=4).
